In recent weeks, we’ve seen the right’s revival of blatant anti-Muslim sentiment, from President Trump describing Democratic candidates as “jihadists” to Vice President JD Vance calling Michigan U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed “very, very evil.” 

On Today, Explained, Vox correspondent Christian Paz speaks on why some Republicans have turned to this playbook to win the midterms.
